UFC (Ultimate Fighting Championship) UFC is a sports organization that organizes mixed martial arts (MMA) fights. Fighters use different techniques, including boxing, wrestling, and Brazilian jiu-jitsu. UFC was founded in 1993 in the United States. The first UFC event took place on November 12, 1993. The president and CEO of UFC is Dana White. He has been the president since 2001. UFC is one of the most popular MMA organizations in the world. Many famous fighters compete in the UFC, such as Islam Makhachev and Jon Jones.
